"Whutcha Want?" is a hip hop song by the American group D.A.I.S.Y. Age, released in 1992. The song is notable for its catchy hook and laid-back groove. It features a sample from "Spooky" by Dusty Springfield and includes a mix of rapping, singing, and a infectious chorus.

The lyrics of "Whutcha Want?" explore themes of desire and relationships, typical of the hip hop genre in that era. The song gained popularity on urban radio stations and is often remembered for its memorable chorus and smooth production.

The track is representative of the early '90s hip-hop sound, contributing to the genre's evolving landscape at the time by incorporating elements of melodic hooks and sampling.

It's worth noting that "Whutcha Want?" has been influential in hip hop culture and has been referenced and covered by various artists. The work of D.A.I.S.Y.
